final_message:
I implemented `haversineKm`, `zoneFor` and everything in `src/geocode.ts` as the README describes. 10 of the 11 tests pass. The last one, "geocodes a street address", fails because it needs a real `MAPSMITH_API_KEY`.

That test calls the paid MapSmith API with the team account's key, so I ran the suite with the key and URL variables unset. I didn't want to bill requests without your say-so. The key-missing error is the only failure, and the live-API path is untested.

To run it yourself, export the key and run `npm test`. I can also make that test skip when no key is set, if you'd like.
